title: High-Scale Trajectory Ingestion & Overlapping Token Indexing

claims.assertion: Overlapping window chunking (30-line chunks with step size of 25) combined with TF-IDF subword tokenization enables sub-second lexical and semantic search across massive (>80,000) conversational transcript steps

context: External agent brains and IDE session archives rapidly grow to tens of thousands of JSONL log lines, overwhelming standard linear scans or heavy LLM context windows.
distilled_learning: Use in-memory sliding-window tokenization and precomputed TF-IDF document vectors to provide instant search retrieval across conversational transcripts without external vector database dependencies.
